where Claude Code's rules are different and this one is honoured: a deny

This is the asymmetry that matters. An allow rule the brain's own
permission layer skips costs the agent a tool; a DENY rule it honours and
the gateway ignores costs the deny entirely — and the gateway is the layer
that exists because the brain holds the capability token and can reach a
server without asking Claude Code anything. The allow rule is wide on
purpose, so a Denied verdict is this deny firing rather than nothing
